ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is a large contiguous dark pigmentation field. High-intensity white fields are located on the distal portions of both lobes. The right distal lobe exhibits high-density dark mottling (speckled blobs) within the white field, while the left distal lobe shows relatively sparse mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels along the trailing edge, particularly prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory observed along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters detected on the white pigmentation of the right lobe tip and mid-left lobe, consistent with rosette-style scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear segments (rake marks) are visible intersecting the high-intensity white field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible structural irregularity and apparent minor tissue loss at the extreme apex of the right fluke tip compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of finger-like dark pigmentation projections extend into the white field of the right lobe near the center of the trailing edge.
